messages:
Amanda Lee: Heads-up — planning a sequential rollout for release v2.8.0 across regions this week. US -> EU -> APAC. Keeping the change window short, aiming for low-risk canary slices.
Jay Park: SGTM. What are the exact holdpoints and rollback thresholds?
Amanda Lee: Proposed flow: US (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%), wait 12m stability after each step. If any step breaches thresholds, stop and roll back. EU/APAC follow same cadence but delayed by maintenance windows.
Rico Mendes: Add infra capacity checks before each region ramp — verify GPU pool free slots, queue length < 5, and node CPU < 75% on avg.
Sofia Patel: Agreed. Also require error-rate checks: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p99 latency increase > 2x baseline triggers hold.
deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: start_canary region=us-west1 release=v2.8.0 slice=10% who=Amanda Lee timestamp=1719502500
Jay Park: Noted — confirm model variant pin: we are pinning to model-id redwood/turbo-v3@2026-03-18 to avoid drift, right?
Amanda Lee: Yes. Pinning enforced in rollout config. Canary uses quantized variant q4_0; fallback plan uses q8_0 if perf issues.
Rico Mendes: Ops checklist before ramp to 50%:
```
- verify warm pool >= expected (10 nodes)
- confirm autoscaler min=8 max=120
- run smoke test (3 requests) against health endpoint /internal/health
- spot-check KV cache hit rate >= 60%
```
Sofia Patel: Quick note on cost: if token/sec rises > 2x baseline during canary, we throttle non-prod within same region and re-evaluate.
deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: canary_progress region=us-west1 slice=10% status=healthy errors=0 p99=120ms gpu_util=62% timestamp=1719502605
Amanda Lee: Good. Proceed to 50% after 12m stable window. Post the 12m metrics snapshot here.
Jay Park: /me will run the regional capacity probe at +8m then again at +11m. Will paste results.
ops-oncall-bot: OPS-ONCALL: capacity_probe result: queue_len=2, free_slots=18, avg_cpu=68% timestamp=1719502720
Rico Mendes: That's green. Also verifying SLO traces for tail latency — nothing anomalous.
deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: ramp region=us-west1 to=50% release=v2.8.0 timestamp=1719502775
Sofia Patel: Monitoring rule: if 5xx ratio spikes > 0.3% within a 1m window AND p90 latency > baseline+150ms, we pause. If 5xx > 0.8% for 2m, we initiate automated rollback.
Amanda Lee: Documenting rollback play: immediate pin back to v2.7.1, traffic-shift to previous model for the region, and create an incident with priority=P1 if rollback occurs.
Jay Park: For EU/APAC schedule: EU can start ramping 2 hours after US full roll, APAC 6 hours after EU start to respect regional business hours.
Rico Mendes: One more ops thing — add a temp throttle policy for embeddings endpoints during rollout to protect capacity.
Amanda Lee: Will add to deploy config. Everyone acknowledge readiness? :thumbsup:
Jay Park: :thumbsup:
Sofia Patel: :thumbsup:
Rico Mendes: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: full_rollout region=us-west1 status=complete release=v2.8.0 timestamp=1719502850
Amanda Lee: Thanks team — next message will be EU preflight at 2 hours. Posting release notes + rollback criteria to the release doc now: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.8.0/notes
